messages:
maria (Marketing): Need a tight, skimmable one-pager + an expanded 2-pg solution brief for enterprise buyers focused on secure deployments (VPC, on-prem, GovCloud). Use cases: webinar follow-up, handoff to AEs, and inbound routing. Target: finalize by Wed morning.
devin (FieldMarketing): Suggested structure for one-pager: 1) Problem + who this is for 2) Key guarantees (SLA, isolation, KMS) 3) Quick deployment options 4) CTA -> book tailored trial. Keep under 300 words.
leah (SalesOps): Routing rules we use now are messy. Proposed mapping:
- ARR >= $200k OR tags includes {regulated, gov, healthcare, finance} -> AE (priority)
- ARR 75k-200k OR compliance=high -> AM + SE discovery
- ARR < 75k -> PLG follow-up (marketing nurture)
Add an override checkbox for "Legal review required".
anil (Eng): Technical blurbs I can provide for brief: short runtime guarantees, fallback policy, and a minimal VPC config example. Snippet: ```SLA: 99.9% uptime monthly. Latency goal: p95 < 200ms on Dedicated for typical gen workloads. Fallbacks: automatic routing to compatible model variants or Dedicated->Hosted with reduced SLOs.```
sofia (Security): Security checklist to call out on both assets: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 badges, support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, Azure KV, customer HSM), audit-log export, and optional air-gapped on-prem package. Add short legal line: "Offers BAA and DPA; contact legal@redwood.com."
maria (Marketing): Good. Devin can you draft the 30s webinar CTA? Need two versions: AE-facing (for demo request) and PLG (nurture).
devin (FieldMarketing): AE CTA (30s): "If your team needs dedicated capacity, private networking, or managed keys, book a tailored trial and our solutions engineers will run a compliance review and performance tune." PLG CTA (15s): "Try Redwood in minutes; upgrade to a dedicated plan for SLAs and private deployment."
leah (SalesOps): For the brief include an explicit lead-handling playbook table. Example row: "Tag: govcloud -> route to AE queue + set priority flag + create Legal intake". Also include sample HubSpot property mapping for automation.
anil (Eng): I'll attach a small graph for the 2-pg brief showcasing cost delta w/ caching + batching (anonymized). Also adding link to VPC docs: https://vpc.redwood.com/docs (ports: 443; optional 9090 for metrics).
sofia (Security): Add a short mitigation note: "During network incidents, automatic multi-tier fallback keeps API available but with reduced latency guarantees; see incidents playbook."
maria (Marketing): Draft assets: one-pager (sales leave-behind) + 2-pg solution brief (technical appendix + routing playbook + benchmark callouts). I'll post links here when drafts are uploaded.
doc-bot: new file uploaded by maria: enterprise-solution-brief-compact-v1.pdf -> https://drive.redwood.com/drive/abcd1234
maria (Marketing): Please review in doc by Tue EOD. Review owners: Devin (messaging/CTAs), Leah (routing/workflow), Anil (technical accuracy), Sofia (security/legal).
devin (FieldMarketing): Quick micro-feedback: for the benchmark blurb, label numbers as "example" and avoid absolute guarantees.
leah (SalesOps): Workflow note: set HubSpot automation to add "priority" task for AE and assign tag "compliance-review" when Legal checkbox is ticked.
anil (Eng): One more technical line to include: "Private deployments can be provisioned with customer-managed control plane in VPCs or fully air-gapped on-prem bundles."
sofia (Security): Final: I'll send a short-approved cert badge image and a one-line legal pre-approval we can paste under the security section.
maria (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll iterate and push v2 by Wed morning. If anyone has blocking edits, ping me here. :rocket:
